selection.method: VAL synthetic translations; fastest within 1 source pixel mean error, or minimum error
selection.fallback: reuse last observations if homography unavailable

limitation: Sparse labelled targets each treated as skipped frame, with actual immediate predecessor. Accuracy is skipped-frame-only; pair cost includes inference/refit/preprocess/flow but excludes video decode. This is an adjacent-pair proxy, not a continuously labelled alternating video.
